extras: Does not make network requests or collect data.
intentEvidence: This plugin renders that block in Obsidian as a collapsible table of contents that matches how it looks in DaiDai.
problem: Notes exported from DaiDai appear with an empty code block that is not functional or readable in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: DaiDai (a privacy-first messaging app made by Rhing) exports its notes as Markdown.

summary: Renders a collapsible table of contents in Obsidian by interpreting a specific `daidai-toc` code block generated by the DaiDai note-taking app.
